QuestInfo.name: More Supplies!
QuestInfo.0: Maroon has a request. Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Maroon tells you that this is the final supply mission.  He asks you to obtain #b30 #t4033418# and 30 #t4033417# items#k. Go to the #m401010100# and the #m401010200# to eliminate #o2400100# and #o2400101# monsters and obtain the supplies.
QuestInfo.2: Maroon apologized for all the requests.

0.0: Your help in getting us ores has been indispensable. I was hoping you could continue helping us.
0.1: We need two more things to get fully equipped. A good stock of both #b#t4033417##k and #b#t4033418##k would turn things in our favor. Would you be willing to help?

yes.0: I knew you would be game. Bring back about #b30 #t4033418# and 30 #t4033417##k. I know that's a lot for you to carry, but I'm sure you'll figure out somewhere to stick it.

no.0: I guess you have more important work...

1.0: Angelic Buster, I've been waiting. Did you bring back the supplies?

item.0: Angelic Buster, you have to bring me #b30 #t4033417# and 30 #t4033418##k. It's not that difficult...
